jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: On site position in Austin, TX The Accessioning Team Runner collects, sorts, and transports packages to Accessioning laboratory in the Austin, TX office. Hourly rate is $17. Shift Options: Monday-Friday, 9am-530pm Hourly rate starts at $17 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Sort and transport packages from the Shipping dock to the Accessioning laboratory. Pick up packages from the receptionist’s desk. Scan all tracking numbers into a Google spreadsheet and ensure that tracking numbers are scanned in correctly and spreadsheet is filled out completely. Distribute packages to the Clinical Data Operators (CDO) in a timely and efficient manner following distribution guidelines. Rack samples that arrive in bulk (without individual kit boxes) ensuring that the paperwork matches up with the samples. Escalate any issues or discrepancies to the Leads or Supervisor. Empty bins filled with kit boxes at the CDO workstations into carts placed at designated locations in the lab. Perform a visual check of the kit boxes to make sure that there is no PHI on the kit boxes or samples remaining in the discarded kit boxes. Empty biohazard cans in the lab. Scan bench worksheets. Scan documents into cases. Maintain tidiness of Runner workstations. Store requisition forms by date into the filing cabinets. Dispose of requisition forms into the shred bins that have exceeded the retention period. Performs other duties as assigned. Notify Supervisor and Leads of any packaging issues or discrepancies This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and has access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire. cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Accessioning Team Runner opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Presence
jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Presence is OpenAI’s team building AI agents that organizations can trust to handle real conversations and get things done. Our mission is to turn advances in frontier models into dependable systems that can resolve customer issues, support employees, and improve through experience in production. Imagine calling about an unexpected charge. An agent needs to understand your situation, verify your identity, find the relevant account information, apply the right policy, and resolve the issue or bring in a person. It needs to do all of this naturally, accurately, and quickly, even when the conversation takes an unexpected turn. Presence brings together the models, execution systems, integrations, and controls that make experiences like this possible across voice, chat and email. One of our most exciting challenges is what happens after an agent goes live. We're building a system for understanding where agents fail and making them better: investigate a production conversation, reproduce the problem in an evaluation, use Codex to develop a fix, test it against the current agent, and measure the result after deployment. Our ambition is to make more of this improvement process agentic over time, while giving people control over what changes reach users. Read the launch announcement https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence/. WHAT WE WORK ON - Realtime voice: Natural conversations with fast responses, interruptions, and reliable audio, even under heavy traffic. - Agent systems: Orchestration, reasoning, tool execution, integrations with company systems, and enforcing permissions and policies. - Agent quality: Production debugging, simulations, evaluation infrastructure, regression testing, and measuring whether changes improve real outcomes. - Product and developer experience: Making it easier for teams to build, test, deploy, and operate sophisticated agents using Codex and OpenAI's capabilities. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: You'll work at the intersection of frontier research, product engineering, and production systems, with a direct feedback loop from people using what you build. We collaborate closely with Research, Forward Deployed Engineers, and customers to understand where models and systems break down and turn those lessons into improvements that can benefit many deployments. The impact is already tangible. At launch, Presence was resolving 75% of issues coming into OpenAI's English phone support without a human, and its Codex-assisted improvement process helped cut transfers to people by 15 percentage points over ten days. Introducing OpenAI Presence https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence/ We're looking for people excited by ambitious engineering problems, building products people depend on, and helping define how AI agents are developed and improved in the real world. YOUR BACKGROUND MIGHT LOOK SOMETHING LIKE: - 9+ years of professional engineering experience, excluding internships, in backend, platform, or product engineering roles. - A track record of hands-on technical leadership, including setting architecture, breaking complex problems into clear implementation plans, and guiding engineers through delivery. - Deep backend engineering and systems design skills, with proficiency in at least one backend programming language and experience designing services, data models, and interfaces that remain reliable as usage grows. - End-to-end ownership of complex systems or product capabilities, from ambiguous requirements and technical design through implementation, launch, and production iteration. - Strong production engineering judgment: you can diagnose difficult failures, reason about performance and scalability, and improve reliability through testing, observability, and operational discipline. - Strong product judgment that connects technical decisions to user needs, with the ability to balance delivery speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. - The ability to move between backend infrastructure and product experiences, contribute across the stack when needed, and quickly learn unfamiliar systems, tools, and domains. - Clear technical communication and effective collaboration across disciplines, including explaining trade-offs, creating alignment, and driving complex work forward while remaining hands-on. - Experience with AI agents, enterprise workflows, integrations, or agent development and evaluation is a plus, but not required. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. cold_email.subject: Interest in Motion Design Producer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear OpenAI Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Motion Design Producer opportunity with OpenAI at OpenAI.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Talent Partner, G&A
jobs.description: ABOUT US: AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. About Modal Talent: Modal is growing fast, and the teams that keep the company running are growing with it. You’ll join the Talent team as the recruiting partner for our G&A functions: finance, legal, People, IT and business systems, workplace, and executive and business operations. You’ll work closely with our Head of Talent and with the leaders who run these teams. The people you hire will build the foundation Modal scales on. The Role: As G&A Talent Partner, you will own hiring across Modal’s G&A teams, from the first conversation to the signed offer. The range is wide. In a single week you might hire a staff accountant, a senior legal lead, and an IT systems admin. These are roles where the candidate pool is smaller, the stakes are high, and the best people are rarely looking. You’ll learn what great looks like in each function, find people before anyone else does, and help them see what it means to build these teams at a company moving this quickly. You’ll also help shape how we hire for G&A: what we look for, how we evaluate it, and how the process improves over time. What You’ll Work On: - Own full-cycle recruiting across G&A, from sourcing through offer and close, including: - Finance and accounting: accounting, controllership, FP&A, tax, treasury, payroll, and procurement - Workplace and facilities: office and workplace operations and events - Executive support and operations: executive assistants, chiefs of staff, and business operations - Partner with function leaders to define hiring needs, scope roles, and calibrate on what great looks like at each level - Source and engage experienced professionals through networks, referrals, specialized communities, and direct outreach, including passive candidates - Pitch Modal to candidates who are weighing us against more established companies, and guide them through our interview process - Work with Talent and People Ops on compensation, leveling, and offer construction so that offers are fair and consistent - Use data and market context to keep searches on track and expectations aligned - Create a candidate experience that is fast, respectful, honest, and discreet, especially for senior and confidential searches - Bring an equity lens to every stage of the process - Try new approaches to finding and hiring in hard-to-recruit functions, and turn what works into repeatable practices You May Be a Fit If: - You have 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a track record of hiring across finance, legal, or other G&A functions - You learn new functions quickly and can recruit across very different roles, from a staff accountant to a senior legal hire to an executive assistant - You’re curious, you ask the right questions, and you want to understand what the work actually looks like before you start searching - You’re high influence, low ego: you move people with insight and honesty, not volume - You handle sensitive information with care and good judgment - You move quickly and communicate clearly, even when priorities shift or things get messy - You’re a strong closer who builds trust early and gets ahead of concerns - You manage multiple searches at once without dropping details or sacrificing candidate quality - You care about people and want everyone to have a thoughtful, fair, and human experience - You’re based in or willing to relocate to NYC or SF

cold_email.body:
Dear Illumina Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Staff Integration Engineer opportunity with Illumina at Illumina.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, B2B SEO & AEO
jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Growth team drives adoption and revenue for ChatGPT. This role focuses on B2B and small-business growth: helping business owners, functional leaders, and teams discover how ChatGPT can solve their work challenges and deliver value. We partner across product, engineering, product marketing, content, design, and analytics to turn customer insights and disciplined experimentation into sustainable growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a growth marketer with deep expertise in search engine optimization (SEO) and a strong experimental approach to answer engine optimization (AEO) to grow ChatGPT adoption among small businesses. You will own the strategy and execution for reaching business buyers through organic search and AI-powered answers, connecting discovery to evaluation, workspace creation, and paid adoption. You will build an organic acquisition program around how small businesses research problems, compare solutions, and choose tools for their teams. Your remit spans technical SEO, search and question research, content strategy, and AEO experimentation. You will partner with SMB Product Marketing and Content Marketing to translate business use cases, industry needs, and customer proof into useful discovery experiences, and with Web Growth to improve the path from organic discovery to conversion. This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Own the B2B / SMB SEO and AEO roadmap, prioritizing opportunities by business audience, use case, industry, buying intent, and potential contribution to customer acquisition and revenue. - Lead keyword, question, and audience research across the small-business buying journey—from identifying a business problem to comparing solutions and evaluating pricing, team adoption, and business requirements. Translate findings into prioritized content briefs and page opportunities. - Own the technical SEO roadmap with web and engineering partners, including crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, internal linking, structured data, and migration readiness. Build durable foundations for discovering and understanding our business content. - Develop and test AEO approaches that help business buyers find accurate, useful information about ChatGPT in AI-powered search and answer experiences. Improve answer-focused content, product information, and supporting evidence; track visibility, citations, and referral quality while distinguishing observed results from hypotheses. - Partner with SMB Product Marketing and Content Marketing on use-case and industry pages, comparison and evaluation content, practical guides, and customer stories. Bring search insights and clear briefs; maintain accuracy, originality, and usefulness as the program scales. - Build measurement with Analytics that connects organic discovery to qualified business traffic, workspace creation, activation, paid conversion, and revenue. Segment performance by intent, audience, and market, and use experiments and cohort analysis to assess impact and attribution limits. - Partner with Web Growth, Design, and Product on landing-page and conversion experiments that help business visitors take the right next step. Align messaging, proof points, calls to action, and onward journeys with buyer intent, then evaluate downstream customer quality. - Build AI-assisted workflows for research, briefing, content refreshes, technical audits, and reporting, with human review and quality controls. Use programmatic approaches where they create distinct value for business audiences. - Coordinate execution across engineering, product marketing, content, web, and analytics partners. Establish a regular testing and learning cadence, and partner on localization to expand proven SEO and AEO approaches into priority markets. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE: - 10+ years in SEO or growth marketing, with a track record of growing qualified organic acquisition for B2B software or products serving small businesses. Experience with self-serve or product-led business acquisition is especially relevant. - Deep technical SEO expertise, including site architecture, crawling and indexing, structured data, migrations, and internal linking, combined with strong judgment about search intent and content quality. - Hands-on experience testing visibility in AI-powered search and answer experiences. You can design an AEO measurement approach, evaluate citations and referrals, and explain what the evidence does—and does not—show. - A strong understanding of small-business buyers and how their needs vary by role, company size, and industry. You can turn customer problems, solution comparisons, and buying questions into a focused organic growth strategy. - Strong collaboration with product marketing, content, engineering, design, web growth, and analytics teams. You can turn insights into clear briefs, prioritize shared roadmaps, and take initiatives through launch and iteration. - Strong analytical and experimentation skills, including search and web analytics, funnel and cohort analysis, and landing-page testing. You connect traffic and visibility to activation, paid adoption, and revenue rather than optimizing for rankings alone. - Hands-on experience publishing, refreshing, and measuring content through a CMS, including landing pages, reusable templates, and localized experiences. You are comfortable moving between strategic planning, technical audits, and page-level QA. - Experience using AI-assisted workflows and programmatic SEO to improve execution while preserving factual accuracy, original value, and a high-quality customer experience. - A test-and-learn mindset, clear communication, and comfort operating in a fast-changing environment. You balance curiosity about new discovery channels with disciplined prioritization and measurement. Dear Illumina Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Staff Scientist, Protein Engineering Lab Automation opportunity with Illumina at Illumina.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Phlebotomist - Las Vegas - Meadows opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Talent Coordinator
jobs.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About the Role: Cohere seeks a high-performing Talent Coordinator, eager to take on a new challenge here in our Talent Operations team at Cohere. You will schedule a high volume of roles as a member of a small but mighty coordination team, who partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure interviews are arranged in a timely manner and that candidates have an excellent experience interviewing at Cohere. If you consider yourself highly organised, collaborative and someone who goes above and beyond to ensure excellence, we’d love to hear from you. In this role you will be a liaison between teams supporting hiring managers, the Talent Team, the People team, and many more. Our Talent Coordinators are a primary internal and external point of contact and are a core part of our TA function supporting the scaling of Cohere. The team is not a behind the scenes support function, they are the beating heart of the Cohere Talent team. You will schedule a high volume of interviews diligently and efficiently, manage a world class candidate experience, build strong and strategic relationships, manage multiple calendars and own the interview process with seamless communication and ownership from start to finish. Our ATS is Ashby and we utilise the Advanced Scheduling functionality! Candidates must be based in Germany to be considered for this opportunity. As a Talent Coordinator, you will: - Schedule a large volume of interviews, ensuring our hiring teams and candidates are supported via seamless communication - Manage the candidate experience and build strong relationships across the organisation - Partner closely with a team of Executive Assistants, Hiring Managers and Recruiters - Support and optimize our interview processes & increase efficiency/automate where possible - Provide status updates, answer questions, and ensure timely follow up for our recruiters and candidate - Support on TA Operations projects where required - Keep our internal documentation up to date, working with detail and organization to ensure scalability and operational efficiency This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you have: - 2+ years of professional work experience supporting a fast paced recruitment team - Experience scheduling a high volume of interviews, managing multiple calendars, and supporting a large volume of interviews with hiring managers and executive teams - Attention to detail coupled with the ability manage a high workload at a demanding pace - A team player "can-do" attitude and a proven track record of partnering with all functions and levels across an enterprise - Possess very strong time management & communication skills - Track record of executing on tasks for high-touch recruitment initiatives thoughtfully and efficiently at a fast pace - Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with tact and discretion - Have a genuine passion for providing excellent candidate experiences FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.
